primary.primary_hypothesis: On Q4_K_M conflict prompts, mean strict action accuracy with historical evidence first differs from accuracy with randomized evidence first.
primary.scoring: strict JSON accuracy; invalid output is incorrect
limitations: The confirmatory claim is limited to these model checkpoints, prompt scaffold, synthetic generator and target rates.
The replication was designed after cohort 015 exposed the order pattern; cohort 015 remains development evidence.
Secondary format interactions and aligned-item order effects are descriptive.

power.primary_test: two-sided one-sample t test of 96 family-level mean paired differences, alpha 0.05
power.outcome: Q4_K_M conflict accuracy, historical-first minus randomized-first
power.method: Generate two paired binary-outcome differences per family from a bivariate Gaussian copula with probabilities P(D=-1)=(d-delta)/2, P(D=0)=1-d, P(D=1)=(d+delta)/2; test family means with a two-sided t statistic.
limitations: Planning simulation, not evidence about model performance.
The 20-point effect is the prespecified smallest effect of interest; discordance and within-family correlation are design assumptions.
The independent sampling unit is the SCM family; two conflict task pairs are nested within each family.

recovery.classification: local exploratory analysis recovery; no new inference
recovery.amendment: Zero-variance/fewer-than-two-family t quantities are null; descriptive contrasts retained.

analysis.classification: exploratory 14B matched-quantization follow-up on reused cohort 016 families
